answers.why: The lamentation concerns the princes who rule Israel as a nation.
Israel's elders come together to enquire of the LORD.
God addresses Israel's elders and condemns their fathers' abominations.
Israel is identified with Jacob's descendants in Egypt whom God would bring out.
The house of Israel is addressed collectively about following its fathers' abominations.
The house of Israel is accused of offering gifts to idols and passing its children through fire.
The mountain of Israel is the nation's holy mountain where its people will worship.
All the house of Israel in the land will serve God and bring offerings.
Israel's princes face the sword together with God's people.
Judah in fortified Jerusalem is a target of the Babylonian king's sword.
Israel names the nation ruled by the wicked prince whose crown will be removed.
Israel's princes are accused of using their power to shed blood in the city.
